cues.text: Camera footage plays: Ken alone in his room at the dorm, holding a long-handled broom like a spear. Ken sets his feet and swings it, lunging and striking at the air.
Ken swings again, and the handle cracks against his own shin. He drops the broom and crouches, clutching his leg.
Ken crosses the room, picks up a carton of milk from the low table and drinks it down.
